subject.title: [Bug]: ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME} is not process when installing a skill

question: Should OpenClaw expand `$VAR` and `${VAR}` inside shared user/workspace path resolvers for skill installs, or keep env interpolation limited to config-load/dotenv semantics?
rationale: The source fix is mechanically small, but the shared resolver is used by config, state, plugin, workspace, secret, and skill paths, so this changes compatibility semantics beyond the reported Docker skill install.

options.title: Adopt resolver expansion
options.body: Land or replace the linked resolver-level fix with regression coverage for configured workspaces and ClawHub skill install targets.

options.title: Keep interpolation at config load
options.body: Document path strings as already-substituted config values and fix only the specific config/install path that should receive expanded values.

options.title: Defer to dotenv policy
options.body: Keep this issue open until the broader dotenv/env-expansion contract is decided in the related issue.

recommendation.title: Adopt resolver expansion
recommendation.body: Land or replace the linked resolver-level fix with regression coverage for configured workspaces and ClawHub skill install targets.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and linked review history both route the shared resolver and skill-install path through this area contributor.
